Installing Plug-Ins

In general, Plug-Ins based on VST Module Architecture have to be installed in the Components folder of the host application e.g. "C:\Program Files\Steinberg\Cubase SX\Components". The host recursively scans this folder at startup.
The file extension on Windows has to be ".dll" and ".bundle" on Mac OS X.
A Shared Components folder is proposed, but not yet supported by Steinberg host applications.
